sentences.text: At nine hundred, steering zero nine zero true at twelve knots, a light bears zero two zero true.
At nine thirty, the same light bears three three zero true.
Plot the second L O P.
In thirty minutes at twelve knots, you ran six miles along zero nine zero.
Pick any point on the nine hundred L O P, measure six miles from it in the direction zero nine zero, and draw a line through that point parallel to the original L O P.
Where it crosses the nine thirty L O P is your nine thirty running fix, labeled R fix.
